params.prompt:
SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE necklace only, lying flat on the top face in a loose open loop, the clasp at the back, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; in it the necklace is worn by a woman in a white top: ignore her, her top, her hair, her long nails and the two white arrow icons, and take only the necklace from it. IMAGE 2 is a close detail of the same piece. IMAGE 3 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A CLASSIC TENNIS NECKLACE: ONE continuous unbroken line of identical small ROUND brilliant-cut clear stones, each in its own four-claw cup, linked edge to edge all the way round with no chain, no gaps, no pendant, no centre station and no buckle; a small box clasp at the back. Every stone is the same size and round, never graduated, never baguette or square; one single row only, never two rows; every stone is icy clear white with rainbow sparkle, never tinted; nothing hangs from it.

SCALE TEST: Each round stone is 3mm, the size of a mustard seed; the necklace is a fine line only 3mm wide and about 40cm long. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: bright rhodium silver tone, never grey or dull, never gold. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
